commands.name: search-teams
commands.summary: Search teams by name via the JSON API (full team record: ids, leagues, stadium, socials, descriptions)

commands.name: search-players
commands.summary: Search players by name via the JSON API (team, nationality, position, birth date)

commands.name: get-event
commands.summary: Get one event/match by its event id (teams, scores, date/time, venue, round, season)

commands.name: get-league-table
commands.summary: Get the league standings table for a league id and season (rank, points, W/D/L, goals, form)

commands.name: list-next-league-events
commands.summary: List the next upcoming events (fixtures) of a league by league id

commands.name: list-team-last-events
commands.summary: List a team's most recent results by team id

commands.name: list-events-by-day
commands.summary: List all events on a given date, optionally filtered by sport

commands.name: list-team-players
commands.summary: List the players and staff of a team by team id

commands.name: list-leagues
commands.summary: List leagues with their ids and sport

commands.name: search-site
commands.summary: Keyword search across teams, players, leagues, venues and events on the website, optionally filtered by sport; returns names and links

commands.name: get-team
commands.summary: Get a team profile page: name, profile info, next event, manager, stadium, leagues, upcoming fixtures and recent results

commands.name: get-player
commands.summary: Get a player profile page: name, bio facts (born, position, team), description, team and league links

commands.name: get-league
commands.summary: Get a league profile page: name, facts, current season and round, upcoming fixtures and recent results

commands.name: list-season-events
commands.summary: List all fixtures/results of a league season (optionally for one team or one round)

commands.name: list-tv-channels
commands.summary: List TV channels for a country, optionally searching channels by name

commands.name: list-tv-events-today
commands.summary: List today's televised sports events for a country, with time (UTC) and channels

commands.name: get-channel-schedule
commands.summary: Get a TV channel's sports schedule for the next 7 days (events with UTC times)

commands.name: list-sport-leagues
commands.summary: List the featured leagues of a sport from its overview page
